I just returned from Thailand and had the most amazing time at Ayurah Spa during their Rejuvenate Wellness Retreat. From start to finish, it was peaceful, luxurious, and deeply healing.

The spa itself is absolutely beautiful—calm, relaxing, and surrounded by nature. I was warmly welcomed with a delicious herbal drink (no sugar, which I loved!) and then had a wellness consultation with Miss Waew. She was so kind and professional, guiding me through a private yoga session where she patiently helped me with poses and breathing techniques.

Next, I experienced a deeply relaxing oil massage and traditional Tok Sen therapy with Miss Na, a skilled and caring therapist. Her touch melted away all my tension—I felt completely renewed. I also had a Tibetan Bowls sound healing session with Miss Nan, which was truly incredible. The vibrations and sounds brought me into such a deep state of calm that words can’t fully describe the benefits.

The day continued with a nourishing organic lunch from their wellness menu—healthy, clean, and absolutely delicious. I ended the retreat with breathwork, meditation with Tibetan bowls, a detoxifying body wrap, and a facial massage. Every step of the experience was thoughtfully designed and delivered with so much care.

I can confidently say this was one of the best spa experiences of my life. If you are looking for a true wellness escape—one that heals your body, mind, and spirit—I highly recommend Ayurah Spa. I will definitely return again.

Also they offer yoga, wellness activities, and meditation free to hotel guests.  I feel rejuvenated and a new person now.

During this trip, I experienced the Pottali Abhyanga treatment, originally priced at 4000, but offered a special rate of 3200. The massage service was exceptional, deserving a five-star rating, though the price is notably higher than typical massages elsewhere. However, at checkout, an additional 10% service fee (calculated based on the original price of 400) and 7% tax were charged, which led me to deduct one star from the overall rating. It’s worth noting these extra fees when settling the bill. For a similar price, I would consider going to the city for a massage, as you can enjoy a treatment lasting over three hours for the same price.
